description: selected_set adapter fixtures: persisted chess records (trimmed) + oracle + SFT object

trimmed.render_map: board_bbox_px and cell_bboxes_px of occupied cells

Required annotation format: set "annotation" to a JSON array of pixel-space piece boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every matching visible piece; use an empty array if none are shown.
Required answer format: set "answer" to the count of matching visible pieces.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[116,116,164,164],[276,116,324,164]],"answer":2}
